capability.instructions: GPT-6 Luna is the default. Choose GPT-6.1 Sol only when the task requires the demanding or exceptional examples. Choose the lowest capability sufficient for `request`; classify the work, not its vocabulary, length, or number of outputs.

criteria.GPT-6 Luna: Examples: rewrite a message, format JSON, write a small function, fix a routine bug, update UI copy.
criteria.GPT-6.1 Sol: Examples: design backward-compatible synchronization, plan a live database migration, diagnose a race across services, reconcile conflicting system requirements; invent an algorithm when known methods fail, develop a new mathematical proof technique, create a protocol for a novel fault model.

effort.instructions: Choose the least reasoning sufficient for `request`. Straightforward multi-step work belongs to medium; uncertainty and difficult verification distinguish higher levels.

criteria.Medium: Examples: fix a typo, edit a known resource, implement a specified function, repeat independent changes, run straightforward checks.
criteria.High: Examples: trace usages before a compatibility-sensitive rename, compare implementation alternatives, inspect dependencies to find a safe change.
criteria.Extra High: Examples: reproduce an intermittent concurrency bug, test competing explanations for inconsistent logs, verify an original proof against adversarial cases.
